item.title: Nish's Daily Reads — 2026-08-06
item.description: I opened the strongest candidates across AI, product, demand, tools, and security. Six survived because each had a concrete detail in a readable primary source. I dropped the rest when they were only pitches, too technical for this feed, or not checkable from the source page.
